The test file specifies **"identity-key-v2"**: `identityKey = SHA-256 hex over (normalizedTelephone | lowerEmail | soundex(lastName))`, asserting `identityKey` matches `[0-9a-f]{64}`.

1. Rewrite `OwnerIdentity.key(...)` to compute `Sha256.hex(normalizedTelephone + "|" + lowerEmail + "|" + soundex(lastName))` — note the key would then need `lastName` (currently `key(Owner)` passes telephone/email/householdId; it would need lastName instead of householdId).
2. Add a soundex utility (Commons Codec `org.apache.commons.codec.language.Soundex` is already on the classpath via the existing `commons-codec` dependency, alongside `Sha256`/`DigestUtils`).
3. Update callers that build/compare the key: `RejectDuplicateIdentity.java` (line 33, uses `OwnerIdentity.key(owner)` and `OwnerIdentity.key(existing)`) and `OwnerMapper.toIdentityKey` (lines 113-115).
4. Update the OpenAPI `identityKey` description + example (openapi.yml lines 2229-2234) and the Javadoc on `OwnerIdentity`, `RejectDuplicateIdentity`, `DuplicateIdentityHandler` which all describe the old `telephone|email|householdId` form.

All file paths above are absolute. Nothing was modified.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner (one of MR, MRS, MS or DR). When present it is used to compose the owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility as a flat single-line address; when the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields are supplied they take precedence and this value is returned as the composed line ('addressLine1' plus, when present, a single space and 'addressLine2'). An owner is valid when it supplies an address in EITHER form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the structured postal address (street number and name). Preferred over the flat 'address' when present; must be non-blank when supplied. Stored and returned normalized (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, common street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the structured postal address (unit, suite, etc.). Stored and returned normalized when supplied, and appended to 'addressLine1' with a single space to form the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Suite 5'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a 4-digit code that is valid for the owner's city region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on create; when omitted the server's current date is used.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when present the owner's ageBand is derived from it against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner has the same last name and postcode (they share a household), and marks it as a declared member so it is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Write-only; not stored.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path of this owner, '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: "/api/owners/1"
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: "Franklin, George"
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, composed as the 'title' followed by a single space and the 'lastName' when a title is present, or just the 'lastName' when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: "DR who"
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: "G.F."
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is the region code derived from the postcode (falling back to the city, else UNKNOWN) and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized E.164 telephone concatenated with the last name.
              type: string
              example: "NSW-1A2B3C4D"
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable shared identifier for owners who share a household, derived deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256(normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode). Owners with the same last name and postcode always carry the same value automatically.
              type: string
              example: "5f2b3c1a-8d4e-3f6a-9b2c-1d0e7a5f4c33"
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year of the registrationDate (fiscal year starting 1 July, identified by the calendar year in which it ends).
              type: string
              example: "NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26"
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points, starting at 0; add 2 when an email is present; add 1 when namesakeCount is 0; add 2 for a household of 3 or more (householdSize >= 3); add 3 for tenure of at least one elapsed fiscal year (the fiscal year of the registrationDate is earlier than the current fiscal year, fiscal years starting 1 July). A newly created owner has zero tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, from 1 to 4, derived from membershipPoints - 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3 points), 3 (4-5 points), 4 (6 or more points).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's locality (region), the REGION segment of the customerCode ('<REGION>-<HASH8>'), i.e. the region derived from the postcode (falling back to the city-to-region table Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD). 'UNKNOWN' when neither the postcode nor the city yields a region.
              type: string
              example: "NSW"
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The owner's IANA timezone derived from the locality/region via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region yields no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: "Australia/Sydney"
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been created for today's business day (a bulk sign-up), otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, shares an existing owner's lastName and postcode with a different telephone, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible (soft) duplicate of, set when possibleDuplicate is true, otherwise absent.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: True when the owner has been soft-deleted (marked deleted while the record is retained); false for a live owner. A newly created owner is false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: "EMAIL"
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The single derived key consolidating all duplicate detection, formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (email and householdId empty when absent). Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identity keys are equal.
              type: string
              example: "+61412345678||"
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans - the '+' and country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: "+61 412 345 678"
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band derived from birthDate against registrationDate; 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, 'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: "ADULT"
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>' (the last two digits of the fiscal year), where the fiscal year starts on 1 July and is identified by the calendar year in which it ends (July-December belongs to the following year, January-June to that same year). Absent when no registrationDate is present.
              type: string
              example: "FY26"
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Summary

I redesigned the owner identity key to the v2 form: `identityKey = SHA-256 hex over (normalizedTelephone + '|' + lowerEmail + '|' + soundex(lastName))`.

**Changes made:**

1. **New utility `NameSoundex.java`** — wraps Apache Commons Codec's `Soundex` (already on the classpath) to fold a last name to its four-character phonetic code, returning `""` for blank/unencodable names. Mirrors the existing `Sha256` utility's plain-utility pattern.

2. **`OwnerIdentity.java`** — `key(...)` now returns `Sha256.hex(normalizedTelephone + "|" + lowerEmail + "|" + soundex(lastName))` instead of the old unhashed `telephone|email|householdId` string. The `key(Owner)` overload now feeds `lastName` rather than `householdId`.

3. **`AssignPossibleDuplicate.java`** — soft-match now triggers when the **identity keys differ** but **`soundex(lastName)` and postcode match** (previously: exact lastName match + different telephone). Removed the now-unused `Objects` import.

4. **`RejectDuplicateIdentity.java`** — 409 detection is unchanged in mechanism (still compares identity keys, still skips deleted owners, still bypassed by `sharesHousehold`); updated its javadoc. The email-domain blocklist already runs first in the pipeline, and the identity key is the single duplicate gate (no separate householdId 409 block existed).

5. **Docs** — updated `OwnerMapper.toIdentityKey` javadoc and the `identityKey` OpenAPI schema description/example to the SHA-256 form.

**Behavioural effects (as specified):**
- Duplicate detection (409) fires only on an identical v2 key (same telephone + email + phonetic last name), still ignoring deleted owners and still applying the blocklist first.
- Two owners with the same last name and postcode but **different telephones** now have different keys → created as a **soft match**, not a 409.
- Soft-match keys off `soundex(lastName)` + postcode with a differing identity key.

The two acceptance tests (`coreIdentityKeyIsSha256Hex` asserting the 64-hex shape, and `coreRejectsDuplicateIdentity` asserting the collision → 409) both pass, and the full suite is green.
